name: AI in Government, Defense and Public Safety: The One-Hour Briefing
description: A free one-hour briefing built on twelve real public-sector jobs, not an overview: summarizing public comments in an approved assistant, extracting SNAP verification documents, flagging PII for FOIA, reviewing an AI-drafted police report, escalating from a 911 virtual agent, handling a facial-recognition lead, checking an AI bench memo, drafting on GenAI.mil, acting on a predictive-maintenance alert, and drafting a grant. Each lesson shows where AI helps, where it must not decide, and the rule that governs that exact task.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Government, Defense and Public Safety

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI in Government, Defense and Public Safety: The One-Hour Briefing

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 9 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 15 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
